sub_criteria.rationale: H1-B: serum albumin is an independently evaluated laboratory requirement. The shared threshold and screening-time qualifier apply to this measurement (X2).

sub_criteria.rationale: H1-B: serum total protein is a distinct independently evaluated laboratory requirement with the shared threshold and screening-time qualifier.
